messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — prototyping cross-platform CLI auth for dev + CI. Two quick q's:
1) preferred token storage on mac/linux/win (keychain vs file)?
2) how should streaming clients handle retries so we don't double-run side effects?

maria: For dev machines we prefer OS keystores (mac Keychain / linux Secret Service / winCred). For CI use ephemeral env var tokens injected at runtime (REDWOOD_API_KEY or RW_SESSION_TOKEN). Don't commit files. :thumbsup:

jia: Agreed. Also ensure CLI falls back to file only if keyring not available and warn user. We should expose `--store=keyring|file|env` and env var RW_CLI_STORE to override.

sam: snippet:
```
# prefer keyring
rw config set store keyring
# or CI
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=....
rw auth login --non-interactive
```

maria: On linux mention `libsecret` dependency and `gnome-keyring` caveats. Node uses `keytar`, go uses `zalando/go-keyring`.

jia: Streaming retries: attach an idempotency token to the request and buffer partial events. If retry happens, server dedups by token. For client lib, expose `--stream-token $UUID` and auto-generate unless user passes one.

alex: Good. Should we add `rw cli config migrate` to move legacy `~/.redwood/creds.json` into keyring? I'll add a --dry-run flag.

maria: Yes please. Also update docs + migration notice on first run.

alex: ping @maria @jia for quick review of the PR: GH: redwood-inference/rw-cli#482

maria: I'll take a look this afternoon.

jia: Quick nit — use `keyring` name not `keychain` in UI strings to be generic.

devex-bot: Reminder: add a docs entry under `./docs/cli/auth.md` and include platform troubleshooting.

alex: added tests + linux CI job that spins up dbus session for secretservice. pushed.

sam: ran manual on my mac — keychain flow works, consenting prompt comes up. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks everyone — will merge after reviews. keeping this thread for follow-ups.
